Lead, not proof: a static array of five 480-byte objects at 0x14f043690 has an atexit destructor named ProbeResults_bfx (ProbeResults_bfx::~ProbeResults_bfx@0x1416163b0 deletes critical sections at +152 and +376); that name came from the matching tool, the global sits in the HavokPhysics static block (HavokPhysics_* functions reference its neighbours), and nothing ties it to bfx::ProbeResults. Left unchanged. Recommended action for the coordinator: keep bfx__ProbeResults as is until the type identity is decided, or rename it to the supply-record name it is proven to be.
